prompt: You are operating the distribution feeder modeled by pandapower `case33bw` with loads at 30% of nominal. A PV plant at bus 17 injects 1.88 MW at unity power factor, which drives one or more bus voltages above the ANSI Range A upper limit of 1.05 per unit. The PV inverter supports volt-var (reactive absorption) control. Determine the minimum reactive power (in MVAr) the inverter must absorb at bus 17 to bring every bus voltage back to 1.05 pu or below. Report the minimum MVAr to one decimal place.
ground_truth: Minimum reactive absorption at bus 17 on case33bw (30% load) with 1.88 MW PV is 0.7 MVAr to hold all voltages <= 1.05 pu (pandapower power-flow bisection).
